title: rbac v2: enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging for data residency controls
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Close a compliance gap for RBAC v2 by enforcing KMS region pinning for customer data encryption keys and by surfacing detailed audit logs when region-mismatch events occur. This PR implements enforcement and an audit-first fallback mode, ties region pinning into the RBAC v2 policy engine, and adds observability and rollout controls. Changes include policy schema additions, KMS client validation, migration to mark existing keys, new audit events, and a canary rollout plan. Related Linear: ENG-3210, SEC-412. Checklist: [x] Policy schema and validation implemented; [x] KMS client region validation and enforcement; [x] Audit event generation and log enrichment; [x] Migration tool to tag existing keys; [x] Integration tests covering region mismatch and fallback; [x] Canary rollout config in helm; [x] Docs and release notes. Backwards compatibility: policy adds an optional "kms_region_pin" attribute. Existing policies default to opt-out until org sets strict enforcement. Rollout plan: enable audit-only mode by default for two weeks, monitor alerts and telemetry (rbac.region_pin.failures), then flip to enforce for enterprise orgs. Risks: potential 403s if keys are mis-tagged; migration tool included to minimize disruption. For details see inline code comments and the migration runbook linked in the PR conversation. This description is a single continuous string per repo conventions.

release_notes: Security: RBAC v2 introduces optional KMS region pinning to enforce data residency controls. Initially enabled as audit-only; enterprise customers can opt into enforcement via policy.strict=true. Migration tool provided to tag existing keys. Observability: new audit events rbac.kms.region_pin.violation and telemetry metric rbac.region_pin.failures. See docs/rbac/v2/kms_region_pinning.md for configuration and runbook.
